scope: One source-context extraction and output-only hash/count audit; no address provider/API acceptance

output.format: UTF-8 JSONL; one ContextHeader followed by source Street/Locality records

reader.passDescription: relation/area-manager first pass; location-aware object and assembled-area second pass
reader.geometrySource: pyosmium locations and AreaManager; no bounding-box approximation

extraction.peakWorkingSetMeasurement: Windows GetProcessMemoryInfo PeakWorkingSetSize; null if unavailable
scopeLimits: Only named highway ways with valid source node coordinates are emitted as Street records.
Only named boundary=administrative/admin_level=8 areas produced by pyosmium are emitted as Locality records.
This does not extract all OSM hierarchy levels, infer parent/child relationships, or claim searchable hierarchy support.
All available source tags are preserved; no expected corpus, house-derived city, guessed translation, or bbox geometry is used.

validation: Five focused mocked extractor checks and compile check passed before the actual run; source was scanned by pyosmium two-pass area assembly exactly once
provenanceLimits: Preserved M1 OSM input reused; extraction timestamps do not imply new download or renewed upstream freshness. Build peak is one Windows process, not serving-stack capacity.
